Basket with square base and round rim. Section of the basketry are dyed red and black. The basket is decorated with a design of spirals and horizontal lines. Bands of red and black pattern swirl diagonally around the basket. The corners are reinforced with split sticks which are also dyed red. The rim is bound with two strips of the same material. The sticks and rim bindings are sewn to the basket with rattan, the sticks extending below the basket to form four feet. [CW [OPS move] 1/11/2016]

Basket with square base and round rim twill plaited from split reed. Some of the elements are dyed red and black, with others left natural. Bands of red and black pattern twist diagonally around the basket. Corners reinforced with split sticks dyed red which form four feet. The rim is bound with two strips of the same material, inside and outside. [CW [OPS move] 1/11/2016]
